design.purpose: A warm two-tone cowl for one adult, worked in the round from the photographed super-bulky yarn: five green rounds and five blue rounds.

steps.c: Place yarn, hook and scissors on table.
Chain 36 and join into a ring.
Work 36 half double crochet around ring.
Work 36 half double crochet around ring.

Work 36 half double crochet around ring.
Join blue yarn at final yarn over.
Work 36 half double crochet around ring.
Work 36 half double crochet around ring.
Work 36 half double crochet around ring.
Work 36 half double crochet around ring.
Work 36 half double crochet, slip stitch closed.
Cut blue yarn, leaving 15 cm tail.
Weave both tails through nearby stitches.
